title: {{NAME}} and the Dinosaur Superhero Who Saved the Day
moral: Everyone has a special power inside them.

pages.content: {{NAME}} stood on top of a big green hill. The town below looked tiny. Big fluffy clouds floated by. Then the ground shook hard. A dinosaur came running up the hill. He wore a cape. A purple superhero cape!

pages.content: The dinosaur's name was Rex. Rex wanted to be a superhero. But Rex did not think he had any special powers. He just felt big and clumsy. {{NAME}} looked at Rex and smiled.

pages.content: Then they heard a cry. A big rock had rolled in front of the town gate. Nobody could get in or out. {{NAME}} tried to push it. It was too heavy. Rex walked down and pushed with all his might.

pages.content: Rex gave one last huge push. The rock rolled away. The town gate swung open. Everyone rushed out cheering. They cheered loudest for Rex. Rex stood up very tall. His cape blew in the wind.

pages.content: Rex knew his power now. His great big strength was his superpower. Everyone has a special power inside them. Goodnight, {{NAME}}. Sleep tight. Rex whispered that he saw something else in the distance that might need a superhero. What could it be?
